summary: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd, a Hong Kong-based ICT solutions provider, filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-10 share consolidation effective October 8, 2026, approved by the board on August 5, 2026. Outstanding shares fall from 16,060,000 Class A and 4,640,000 Class B to roughly 1,606,000 and 464,000, respectively, with fractional shares rounded up. Trading continues on Nasdaq under symbol GLE with new CUSIP G39711117. The stated objective is regaining compliance with Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2); the company relied on home-country practice to bypass shareholder approval. Watch trading behavior and compliance confirmation.
